title: Norm Technology Absolutely Feature Complete
description: Create the norm technology as headless Rust crates for end-to-end norm compliance computation: shared norm_core plus one family crate per listed path (norm/din/v/18599, norm/din/4108, norm/din/en/16798, norm/en/1990-1999), each implementing every part of that family with German national annex where applicable.
summary: Closed all remaining completeness gate gaps across 13 norm family crates. Energy: DIN 4108 check_full_envelope (parts 1–8, rh_int humidity correction), DIN EN 16798 ISO 7730 PMV/PPD + check_full_environment (parts 1–17 + na_de), DIN V 18599 balance_annual all 12 parts with clause-cited primary energy factors and distinct part_12 tabular method. Basis: EN 1990 persistent/accidental/seismic combination sets in evaluate; EN 1991 check_full_actions covering parts 1_1–1_7 and 2–4. Materials: EN 1992 prestress + optional FEM path; EN 1993 part_1_5_plated buckling + check_full_steel_member + FEM; EN 1994–1999 full check_full_* aggregators with expanded Documents; EN 1998 base shear uses design spectrum s_d + parts 2–6. All 130 unit tests pass (isolated CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/semio-norm-target-fc2). Checklist updated to complete.
